thread:
maria: Hey folks — noticed paging alerts for the embeddings->reranker pipeline at ~15:02 UTC. Customers on paging routes are seeing 500s and some search results with empty lists. Opening thread to collect logs and coordinate live mitigation.
incident-bot: [ALERT] severity=sev2; service=reranker-batch; started=2026-03-15T15:02:11Z; alert_id=INC-20260315-001 :pager:
ashwin: Oncall here. I’ll grab the initial logs. Which customer/route is being hit most?
maria: Looks like the paging endpoint /v1/rerank/batch from the pages-worker queue. Top impacted customer is org-id: 8421cc (high traffic). Errors started spiking exactly at 15:02:09 UTC. 5xx rate ~18% for 2xx baseline of 0.2%.
leo: I pulled the first error sample from the API gateway logs: 
```
2026-03-15T15:02:09.124Z ERROR handler - batch_rerank failed - downstream error: NullPointerException at com.redwood.reranker.RankService.apply(RankService.java:162)
request_id=req_0a3f4b, org=8421cc, route=/v1/rerank/batch, batch_size=64
```
carmen: NPE in java service — but our reranker is serving vectors from embedder. Could be vector shape mismatch. Any vector length mismatches in the embedder logs?
devin: Checking embedder logs. I see a hot path change deployed at 14:58 UTC (canary) that landed a change to padding behavior for empty docs. Relevant log: 
```
2026-03-15T14:58:02.553Z INFO embedder - apply_padding_mode=TRIM_EMPTY; model=embed-precise-2b-q8
```
maria: That timing fits (deploy -> spike). Do we have samples of the vectors being returned to reranker? Need to compare lengths.
\
eva-ml: I grabbed a few encoded payloads from the worker queue (S3 snapshot). Most vectors are length 1536, but ~12% of entries are length 0 (empty arrays) or length 1. Example payload (truncated): 
```
{"doc_id":"abc123","vector":[]}
{"doc_id":"abc945","vector":[0.001,-0.002,...]}
```
ashwin: If the reranker code assumes fixed-length vectors and does array accesses like `vector[i]`, NPEs (or OOB) makes sense. We should treat this as vector-shape mismatch introduced by embedder change.
\
incident-bot: [NOTE] creating incident channel #inc-8421cc-rerank (private) and paging PD schedule updated. Please do on-call handoff if needed. :white_flag:
\
leo: Live mitigation suggestions: 1) Roll back embedder padding change; 2) Add defensive guard in reranker to skip zero-length vectors; 3) Short-term: drop batch requests that include any empty vectors and respond 200 with de-duped partial results to reduce customer impact. Which is fastest?
carmen: Rollback is fastest for full fix if the change was deployed as a single canary. Devin — can you revert the 14:58 canary to previous container tag? If rollback takes >5m, add the defensive check.
devin: Starting rollback now. Triggering release: `releases/rollback embedder canary -> tag embed-precise-2b-q8@20260315-01` 
(rolling back canary to 20260315-00)
maria: Oncall handoff in 10m. Ashwin — can you add runtime guard in reranker? Even a `if (vector == null || vector.length < EXPECTED_LEN) {skip; log metric:rerank.bad_vector}` will reduce NPEs.
ashwin: I can hotfix the reranker runtime check in prod (small patch). Pushing a quick patch to the JVM agent that wraps calls. ETA ~8m.

(08:14: proved steps — logs in thread to track timeline)
\
devin: Rollback completed at 15:07:42 UTC across 3 canaries. Monitoring metrics...
\
leo: After rollback, 5xx rate dropped to 1.4% by 15:10 UTC and back to baseline (~0.3%) by 15:14 UTC. Some downstream retries still failing due to cached bad entries in the batch queue.
\
ashwin: Patch deployed at 15:12:20 UTC — added guard + metric. I can see `rerank.bad_vector` incrementing ~1.2k during the incident period; these were skipped. Patch logs: 
```
15:12:21 INFO reranker - skipped 312 bad vectors in batch req=req_0b5f
```
\
maria: Customer-facing impact: org 8421cc reported partial search failures and 5-minute degraded results window. We should prepare customer note. Also need to check if any persisted downstream artifacts (indexing jobs) consumed empty vectors.
\
eva-ml: Hypothesis list (track):
- H1: Embedder padding change produced zero-length vectors for empty doc inputs — primary cause.
- H2: Reranker lacked defensive checks — contributing cause.
- H3: Queue replays/cached tasks caused extended errors after rollback — secondary cause.
\
leo: Evidence mapping: H1 supported by embedder config change at 14:58 and S3 payloads with empty arrays. H2 supported by stack traces pointing to unguarded array access. H3 supported by continued errors after rollback and logs showing old tasks consumed from pages-worker queue until 15:13.
\
carmen: Next steps for RCA:
1) Collect full list of affected orgs (from gateway logs) — action: maria (done: 8421cc, 9307ad, 1992fb).
2) Trace replayed messages and clear bad entries in the queue — action: devops (devin).
3) Add unit test + CI check in embedder for padding modes — action: eva-ml.
4) Add runtime assertion in reranker and alert if >0 bad_vectors/min — action: ashwin.
\
devin: Cleared ~850 bad queue messages at 15:13:30 UTC (script `tools/queue-scrub --service pages-worker --filter bad_vector`). That lowered residual errors.
\
incident-bot: [INCIDENT STATUS] severity downgraded to sev4 at 15:18Z after rollback and scrub. Incident commander: maria. Duration: 16m.
\
maria: Good work. For the postmortem I’ll gather timeline and assign owners. Please paste any relevant logs or S3 snapshots into the postmortem doc (link: https://redwood.atlassian.org/rumps/INC-20260315-001). Include the `req_` ids you captured.
\
ashwin: Adding PR to add guards + metric: https://github.com/redwood/reranker/pull/312 (hotfix merged)
\
eva-ml: Adding CI regression for padding mode and making default to PAD_ZERO instead of TRIM_EMPTY. I'll also run a synthetic test for batch of empty docs.
\
leo: Final quick notes for the RCA thread: root cause = embedder change to padding behavior led to variable-length vectors (including zero-length), which the reranker assumed were fixed-length. Contributing factor: lack of defensive checks in reranker; mitigation: rollback + hotfix + queue scrub.
\
maria: I'll label this for a full postmortem and schedule follow-up with eng-ml and eng-runtime to review packing/contract & add a contract test that enforces vector length. Thanks everyone. Closing live coordination thread. :white_check_mark:
